# AKA Motions

> AKA Motions is a cinematic video production and photography studio founded in 2023 by brothers Kanthamet ("Junior") and Kanthawat ("Justin"). Based in Melbourne, the studio films music festivals, events, brand commercials, and corporate and hospitality content worldwide. Tagline: "Where Motion Becomes Cinema."

## Key facts

- Website: https://akamotions.com/
- Email: info@akamotions.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/aka_motionnn/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61587397832474
- Based in: Melbourne, Australia, filming worldwide
- Founded: 2023
- Track record: 13 festival/event productions and 30+ commercial/brand productions
- Services: event and festival videography, brand and commercial video, corporate video, hospitality and restaurant video, event photography, full pre-production (concept, storyboards, messaging), filming, editing and post-production
- Turnaround: a 60-second highlight reel within 48 hours of an event; full-length documentaries typically take 3–6 weeks including review rounds
- Booking: pricing is quoted per project based on scope, shoot scale, turnaround and deliverables; a 50% deposit secures the booking date
- Rights: full usage rights transfer to the client on final payment; AKA Motions keeps portfolio rights unless confidentiality is requested
- Travel: for single-day shoots the client covers transport; multi-day shoots also need accommodation
